protocol.optimizer: MFVLR p8: Adam, initial LR 1e-4, weight decay 1e-3; LR multiplied by 0.1 after each 15 completed epochs
protocol.optimizer_assumptions: Adam betas=(0.9,0.999), eps=1e-8; uniform weight decay including CMC log_temperature is a project choice because the paper does not specify parameter-group exemptions
protocol.budget: Internal pilot: 1000 train images, batch2, 5 epochs; not the paper's full training budget. No LR drop occurs before completion of epoch15; total epochs and early stopping in the paper remain unknown
protocol.subset: 500 real + 500 Diffae; existing validation/test manifests unchanged
protocol.rgb: RGB float32 [0,1], PIL bilinear resize to 224x224, no augmentation
protocol.mask: supplied dataset binary mask, nearest resize to 224x224; real target zero
protocol.model: Existing resize_conv_v1, bottleneck only, stop_all, class weights [1,4]. This config changes optimization only
protocol.language: Current implementation: four 77-slot segments, fixed position307 pooling, LR includes PAD, raw-dot CMC, one VIM residual; separately agreed model/loss changes are not implemented by this config
protocol.limitations: Internal pilot, not full paper reproduction; source/identity mapping not independently verified; optimizer details not stated in the paper remain declared engineering choices
